name: Heaven’s Cloud
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level cleric/oracle 6, druid 6, legendary inquisitor 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (1 vial of holy water)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Effect fog spread in 20-ft. radius, 20 ft. high
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as acid fog, except that it only damages corporeal undead.
